review_scope: Exhaustive archive, section and paragraph completeness checks; targeted five-language editorial comparison of evidence boundaries, central argument, conclusions and idiom. Selected source slips checked against published records. Not independent line-by-line historical certification of all ten manuscripts.
notes: Final batch: 60 paragraphs per EP21 edition and 80 per EP22 edition; 700 paragraphs across ten manuscripts. Preserve all eight sections and the argument of each essay.

EP21 preserves the distinct populations and reporting periods behind migrant-death figures, acknowledges real labour reforms without claiming full implementation, and distinguishes allegations and disciplinary sanctions from criminal judgments.
Broaden three EP21 translations from the specific diagnosis heatstroke to heat-related illness, matching the scope of the source.
EP22 retains distinctions between regulation-time and whole-match statistics, a second yellow and a straight red, budgets and reported revenue claims, and interpretation versus official findings.

EP22: remove the unsupported universal USD 575 group-stage floor and its two recurrences. Note FIFA's published USD 60 entry tier without implying universal availability. Qualify final-ticket figures as listings, not completed sales.

EP22: the heat study analyzed 94 matches at that point, not the entire 104-match tournament; its satellite estimates describe stadium surroundings, not on-pitch measurements. Hydration breaks had been announced before the tournament and do not prove every match reached dangerous heat.
Apply the same limited corrections to Chinese and English under standing editorial authorization; other protected source HTML remains unchanged. No separate Traditional Chinese edition is added.

All 22 episodes now have reviewed full editions in German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean. This receipt records integration and targeted editorial review, not a blanket guarantee of every historical detail.

sources.supports: Official final report: Spain won 1-0 after extra time, Ferran Torres scoring in the 106th minute.
USD 60 Supporter Entry Tier exists; USD 575 is not a universal minimum.
Reported late final-ticket listings near USD 32,000 and SeatGeek average listings above USD 11,000, not verified completed sales.
Reuters analysis reproduced here: sample of 94 matches; satellite WBGT for wider stadium surroundings, not actual stadium readings; 35/27 FIFPRO-threshold counts.
7 December 2025 announcement: hydration breaks in every match regardless of weather; not a response to the later 94-match analysis.

ep21.fr.before: Et les bienfaits des réformes sont réels. L’évaluation finale du programme de coopération par l’Organisation internationale du travail est explicite : parmi les travailleurs migrants à bas salaire interrogés en 2022, 86 % disaient que les réformes avaient eu des effets positifs. En 2023, environ six cent soixante-dix mille demandes de changement d’emploi avaient été approuvées ; plus de deux cent quatre-vingt mille travailleurs avaient directement bénéficié de la loi sur le salaire minimum. Même le nombre de consultations pour coup de chaleur avait sensiblement baissé. On ne saurait rayer tout cela d’un trait.

ep21.es.before: Y los beneficios de la reforma fueron reales. La evaluación final del programa de cooperación de la Organización Internacional del Trabajo lo expresa con claridad: el 86 % de los trabajadores migrantes de bajos salarios encuestados en 2022 declaró que las reformas habían tenido un efecto positivo; para 2023 se habían aprobado unas 670.000 solicitudes de cambio de empleo; la ley de salario mínimo había beneficiado directamente a más de 280.000 trabajadores, e incluso habían descendido de forma notable las consultas médicas por golpes de calor. Nada de eso debería borrarse de un plumazo.

ep22.de.before: Ein weiteres Hindernis an der Tür war der Preis. Erstmals arbeitete eine Weltmeisterschaft mit dynamischen Eintrittspreisen. Auf dem Zweitmarkt lag der durchschnittliche Preis einer Finalkarte zeitweise über 11.000 US-Dollar. Wer sie zu einem einzigen „Ticketpreis“ verrührt, kann am Ende gar nichts mehr klar benennen.

ep22.fr.before: Un autre obstacle se dressait à l’entrée : le prix. Cette édition était la première Coupe du monde à recourir à la tarification dynamique. Des articles faisaient état de billets pour la phase de groupes à partir de cinq cent soixante-quinze dollars américains, et de places pour la finale allant jusqu’à trente-deux mille dollars. Sur le marché secondaire, le prix moyen d’un billet pour la finale a un temps dépassé onze mille dollars. On a même vu des annonces à des montants extravagants : manifestement, il ne s’agissait pas de prix auxquels une vente avait eu lieu, mais de chiffres affichés dans une annonce. Une précision s’impose : il faut distinguer les différentes catégories de prix. Le tarif initial officiel, le prix sur la plateforme officielle de revente, celui des places avec prestations d’hospitalité et les montants demandés sur les marchés secondaires extérieurs sont quatre choses différentes. En les fondant dans un seul et même « prix du billet », on ne sait plus de quoi l’on parle.

Vingt-sept dépassaient même son seuil supérieur de chaleur extrême. ep22.es.before: Otro obstáculo a la entrada fue el precio. Este fue el primer Mundial con precios dinámicos: se publicó un precio de partida de quinientos setenta y cinco dólares para la fase de grupos, mientras que las entradas de la final llegaron a los treinta y dos mil dólares. En el mercado secundario, el precio medio de las entradas de la final llegó a superar los once mil dólares. Incluso aparecieron anuncios con cantidades desorbitadas que, evidentemente, no eran precios de operaciones cerradas, sino cifras expuestas a la espera de comprador. Hay que distinguir las referencias que se utilizan: el precio inicial oficial, el de la plataforma oficial de reventa, el de las localidades con servicios de hospitalidad y el de los anuncios en mercados secundarios externos son cuatro cosas diferentes. Mezclarlas bajo la etiqueta de «precio de las entradas» impide aclarar nada.

edits.before: 另一道拦在门口的东西,是价格。本届是世界杯第一次使用动态定价:小组赛的起售价被写到五百七十五美元,而决赛的票价高至三万两千美元;二级市场上,决赛门票的均价一度超过一万一千美元,甚至出现了标价高得离谱的挂单,那种价格显然不是成交价,而是挂在那里的数字。需要说清的是,票价的口径必须拆开看,官方初售价,官方转售平台的价格,场馆招待席的价格,以及外部二级市场的挂单,是四件不同的事,混成一个票价来谈,谁也说不清。
edits.after: 另一道拦在门口的东西,是价格。本届是世界杯第一次使用动态定价:国际足联曾公布数量有限的六十美元入门票,而决赛前部分门票的挂牌价已高至三万两千美元;二级市场上,决赛门票的平均挂牌价一度超过一万一千美元,甚至出现了标价高得离谱的挂单,那种价格显然不是成交价,而是挂在那里的数字。需要说清的是,票价的口径必须拆开看,官方初售价,官方转售平台的价格,场馆招待席的价格,以及外部二级市场的挂单,是四件不同的事,混成一个票价来谈,谁也说不清。

edits.before: Another barrier at the door was price. This was the first World Cup to use dynamic pricing: group-stage tickets started at $575, while final tickets listed as high as $32,000. On the secondary market, average final-ticket prices at one point exceeded $11,000, with some listings priced so absurdly high they clearly weren't transaction prices at all, just numbers left hanging there. The figure needs unbundling: official face value, official resale-platform prices, hospitality-suite prices, and outside secondary-market listings are four different things, and folding them into a single "ticket price" leaves the conversation unclear from the start.

edits.before: So this edition produced its starkest contrast right here: the container was built to the largest scale in history, and the door that actually decided who got to walk through it was never on that container at all. It sat behind a visa officer's window, on a ticket priced from $575 up, inside three sets of entry rules that don't talk to each other. You can expand the stadiums to sixteen, the teams to forty-eight, total attendance past six million — every one of those numbers can be made bigger. That referee, documents in order, turned away anyway — he isn't inside any of those numbers.

edits.before: Take heat. One study, based on satellite data, found that of this tournament's ninety-four matches, thirty-five hit the international players' union's cooling-break threshold, twenty-seven of which exceeded an even higher extreme-heat threshold. FIFA's response was a mandatory three-minute hydration break at the midpoint of both halves, applied uniformly across every match regardless of that day's actual temperature. Wenger acknowledged on July 18 that the policy drew mixed reactions and would need re-evaluating on whether to keep it.
edits.after: Take heat. One study, based on satellite data, found that of the ninety-four matches analyzed at that point, thirty-five hit the international players' union's cooling-break threshold, twenty-seven of which exceeded an even higher extreme-heat threshold. These satellite estimates described stadium surroundings, not measurements inside the grounds. FIFA had already scheduled a mandatory three-minute hydration break at the midpoint of both halves, applied uniformly across every match regardless of that day's actual temperature. Wenger acknowledged on July 18 that the policy drew mixed reactions and would need re-evaluating on whether to keep it.

edits.before: Translate that arrangement into what it actually feels like in a human body: in a match that decides whether you advance or go home, play stops at the halfway point and twenty-two men walk to the sideline to drink water, because if they don't stop, their bodies will start to break down. It is a very concrete reminder that this sport is, in the end, carried out by flesh and blood — and that the schedule, the kickoff times, the broadcast windows are arranged ahead of and around those bodies, not the other way around.
